title: Fix WebView progress refresh dependency
summary: Restores the missing WebView dependency used by compact pending-drain progress rendering.
reason: A progress-view module split left progressUsePendingDrainCompactText outside the extracted presentation module's dependency list, causing affected Refresh renders to throw a ReferenceError.
behavior_before: Refresh fails when compact pending-drain progress rendering calls the undefined formatter dependency.
behavior_after: The presentation module receives the formatter explicitly and compact pending-drain progress renders normally.
manual_validation: Targeted compact pending-drain renderer and CSV completion WebView tests passed; Node syntax checks passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the single injected dependency line; no backend state or media files are affected.
notes:
Inject the compact pending-drain formatter into the extracted presentation module. Existing WebView rendering coverage already exercises the compact pending-drain branch. Refresh the generated source summary after the WebView change.
Restore the WebView test harness UI-helper stub so compact pending-drain rendering reaches the regression branch.
Declare the compact pending-drain formatter as an explicit presentation-module dependency.
Refresh the generated summary after the presentation-module dependency repair.
